notes: Single class 0x7104f87db8 (200 bytes). Constructor inlined in the boma builder f_71006882d0: allocates 0xC8, stores vptr and boma, module kept at boma+0xB0. Setup is vtable 0x28 (f_71004686c0): copies counts and arrays from a descriptor. Per-index fields use path [array pointer offset, field offset]; element = base + index*stride. Status setters re-evaluate get_total_status(0) and broadcast a change event (kind 7) when it differs from the cache at 0xA0. Null slots resolved from the vtable: set_check_catch 0xE8 -> f_7100469cb0, set_invincible_frame_global 0x130 -> f_710046a650, set_no_team 0x188 -> f_710046a930, sleep 0x70 -> f_7100469390. get_center_pos returns a vec from group[entry.group_index] shape pointer +0x30+8*part through its virtual +0x20. 0x10..0x57 looks like an embedded shared collision-set object handled by helpers around 0x71003e....; names of 0x34, 0x4a, 0x50, 0x54, 0x78, 0x90, 0xa6, 0xa8, 0xb0-0xc0 are unresolved.
